Summary: mid-size RegTech firm building RAG-powered document search for regulatory filings and customer dispute resolution. Main constraints: strict UK/EU residency, low-latency search for UK customers, and cost-per-query pressure for high QPS.

Quick bullets / CRM-style entries:
- Use case: primary = doc-search + embeddings; secondary = reranking for precision on top-50 results (cross-encoder).
- Index size: currently ~120M documents (mixed text + PDFs), avg doc length 1.2k tokens, expect 3x growth in 12 months.
- Embedding dim: evaluating 1536/1024 pipelines; want batching/quantization guidance for cost reduction.
- Reranking: candidate retrieval from ANN then cross-encoder ranker for top-50; target p95 latencies must include reranker cost.
- Latency targets: p95 (EU/UK PoP) <= 200ms end-to-end for single-vector search + lightweight rerank; p99 SLA required for enterprise contract.
- Throughput: peak 1500 QPS (search + rerank) for UK region during trading hours; typical sustained 300 QPS.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost/query <= €0.004 (embeddings + retrieval + rerank amortized). customer stressed ROI vs managed vector DB + homegrown ranker.
- Deployment asks: prefer Redwood Private in EU with optional UK POP (data residency contractually required). multi-region routing + graceful failover to EU when UK PoP degraded.
- Security: SSO/SAML, ISO27001 evidence, SOC2 + audit logs, KMS/HSM integration. retention controls for PII redaction and 7y audit log retention.
- Integrations: Kafka streaming ingest for near-real-time indexing, S3/MinIO source connectors, redis for ephemeral KV cache.
